200m John Regis commenced the season with a series of moderate runs by his standards while rounding into shape after injury and the first sign of the form to come was shown when he duffed up Derek Redmond over 300m in late July.
1, GBR (R.Black 44.7, D.Redmond 44.0, J.Regis 44.22, K.Akabusi 44.59) 2:57.53 (European, Commonwealth and Championship Records; 4th fastest of all time); 2, USA 2:57.57; 3, JAM 3:00.10.
Roger Black and Derek Redmond have done their work well and now it is up to John Regis to keep breathing down the neck of the USA's Danny Everett.
He was only a few metres down on Black, World Champion Pettigrew and British Record holder Derek Redmond, although Michael Johnson was in a class of his own with 43.98.
